drhp.business: The company began in 2003 as a two-wheeler transport solution provider to a multinational automobile company and has grown into an automobile transportation business with a network across the country. It provides Full Truck Load (FTL) and Less than Truck Load (LTL) services, delivering clients' shipments via an IT-enabled, GPS-monitored fleet and consignment tracking system.

litigation.note: The company was admitted into Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 pursuant to a petition filed by a Financial Creditor; a settlement was executed with the Financial Creditor, Capital Trade Links Limited, and the withdrawal application under Section 12A was admitted by the NCLT vide order no. IA-1717/ND/2025 dated 21.08.2025, discharging the Company from insolvency proceedings — read in the Secretarial Audit Report (Annexure-IV).

risks.note: Business may be affected by interest rates, changes in Government policy, taxation and other economic developments affecting India; company relies on a favourable debt/equity ratio and geographic diversification to mitigate this.
Business affected by rise and fall in cargo levels in the country; the segment is described as relatively high-margin but dependent on timely delivery of cargo in India.
Requires various approvals, licenses, registrations and permissions to operate; delays or inability to obtain these could adversely affect revenues.
Liquidity risk can arise from blockage of funds in the hands of customers, disrupting smooth operations despite bank support.
Business execution depends on project management skills and timely delivery; delays in implementation can impact revenue and profit for the period.

Threats flagged include competition from local and multinational players, a highly disorganized logistics sector, and a shortfall in skilled management/client service personnel due to inadequate training institutions.
Explicitly flagged as a threat; the company also discloses it has only one permanent employee on its rolls as at 31 March 2026.

Statutory auditors issued a qualified opinion citing material uncertainty on going concern, negative net worth, current liabilities exceeding current assets, and default in repayment of borrowings during the year.
